module.name: Mob tab
egg.note: These settings apply to mobs spawned from this egg.
drops.hint: Chance the item in this slot drops when a player kills the mob. Above 1 it always drops, undamaged.
slot.head: Head
reset.hint: Back to the default chance of %s
health.hint: Capped at the mob's max health when it loads
flag.persistence_required.hint: PersistenceRequired: the mob stays even when no player is nearby
flag.no_ai.hint: NoAI: the mob doesn't move, attack or react
flag.can_pick_up_loot.hint: CanPickUpLoot: the mob picks up and equips items on the ground
flag.left_handed.hint: LeftHanded: the mob uses its left hand as its main hand
flag.silent.hint: Silent: the mob makes no sounds
flag.glowing.hint: Glowing: the mob has an outline visible through blocks
flag.invulnerable.hint: Invulnerable: the mob only takes damage from creative players and the void
flag.custom_name_visible.hint: CustomNameVisible: the custom name shows without looking at the mob
command.mob: Edits the drop chances and flags of the mob you're looking at or the held spawn egg
